tools.name: find_campgrounds
tools.description: Search CampWatch's supported Australian campground catalogue. Use returned provider and slug for availability and alerts.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List supported booking systems and regions.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check current availability for a campground, dates and party size. A result is a snapshot; errors do not prove no availability.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List the connected account's alerts. Default is active; pass ACTIVE,STOPPED,EXPIRED to see all.

tools.name: enable_sms_alerts
tools.description: Enable SMS delivery for all alerts on the connected account, only after the user approves SMS notification intent. New phone-linked accounts have no delivery channel until configured. This preserves push settings and never starts a purchase.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create an SMS/push alert after the user approves target, dates and party size. Use a new idempotencyKey for each intended alert; reuse it on retries. Available-now results can consume an alert credit under CampWatch's existing rules.

tools.name: stop_alert
tools.description: Stop one alert owned by the connected account. It can be reactivated.

tools.name: reactivate_alert
tools.description: Reactivate a stopped alert owned by the connected account.

tools.name: credit_balance
tools.description: Read the connected account's free and purchased alert credits.

tools.name: credit_history
tools.description: Read the connected account's credit ledger.
